added: Pre-generate chunks with Chunky from the Worlds tab — install, start, pause and follow progress in the app.
Disk usage for a server: what takes up space, plus one-click cleanup of old logs, crash reports and memory dumps.
World map views: time players stayed, last saved, entities, block entities, size, generation status and data version per chunk.
Scheduled restarts can warn players in game: choose when, how (chat, tellraw or title) and what to say.
The agent screen shows which Claude and Codex account is signed in (name, email and plan).
changed: The Worlds tab lists every world and dimension in one flat list.
The agent uses much less of your plan: start and restart wait for the server and return a short summary, and console reads only return new lines.
Bookmarks made by clicking the map use the real ground height.
The chunk cleanup notice for SSH servers says the whole server folder is backed up first.
fixed: SSH servers with crash restart no longer hide why a server stopped right after starting.
Stopping an SSH or panel server from its console or in game was recorded as a crash in Run history.
Chunk cleanup could leave old mobs and item frames behind if a side file couldn't be read.
Chunk cleanup couldn't be applied to a server that had crashed.
Mod update warnings said a needed mod was missing when it was installed by hand.
Dragging the world map, or right-clicking it, could open the bookmark window.
The loaded chunk list no longer gets in the way on servers that can't provide it, such as Folia.

added: Loaded chunks on the world map — blue for loaded, orange for force-loaded (needs addon 25).
Chunk cleanup in the Worlds tab: removes chunks players barely stayed in to make worlds smaller, with a backup first.
Run history in the Logs tab: starts, stops and crashes with exit code and uptime.
SSH servers can restart themselves after a crash, even while the app is closed.
Save the world map as a PNG, and click the map to add a bookmark.
Compare a server's start settings, server.properties and mods with another server.
Update warnings when a new mod version needs a mod you don't have or clashes with one you have.
Keep only the newest scheduled backups (Settings).
Quick-start cards in the agent chat, and the agent can install or update the Monolab addon.
changed: The agent signs in inside the app only and no longer borrows the Claude or Codex sign-in on this computer. Sign in once in the Agent tab.
Panel servers show Disconnected instead of Stopped when the panel can't be reached.
Hand-uploaded mods on panel servers show their real name and version.
The What's new button in the update notice sits next to Update now.
fixed: Codex chat failed when the Codex app was set to a model the command line can't use, and couldn't use the app's tools.
The settings search bar covered dialogs opened from Server settings.

added: Reports which chunks are loaded and which are force-loaded, every 5 seconds.
